candidateAudit.text: So schön war unsere Saisoneröffnung mit LIMUKA limuka_sing_in_a_band_karaoke letztes Jahr. ❤️ Deshalb sagen wir: Kommt diesmal wieder vorbei! Denn bei unserem Jubiläumsauftakt heißt es: 🎤 OPEN DOORS, OPEN STAGE! 🎤 30 Jahre Sargfabrik – und die Bühne gehört euch! LIMUKA macht euch zum Star des Abends: Solo, im Duett oder gleich mit der ganzen Freundesrunde. Über 380 Songs warten darauf, von euch gemeinsam mit einer echten Liveband auf die Bühne gebracht zu werden. Ihr singt. LIMUKA spielt. Wir feiern. 🪩 Und wenn gerade niemand am Mikro steht, übernimmt DJ Andi Fraenzl und sorgt dafür, dass die Stimmung garantiert nicht abreißt. ✨ Kommt früher zur Vernissage von Irena Eden & Stijn Lernout, stoßt mit uns an und startet mit uns ins große 30-Jahre-Sargfabrik-Jubiläumswochenende. Also: Song aussuchen, Mut zusammennehmen und Bühne frei! 👉 Die Songliste findet ihr auf limuka.at Wer kommt? Wir freuen uns auf euch! 🧡 #Sargfabrik #30JahreSargfabrik #LIMUKA #LiveKaraoke #karaokewien

candidateAudit.text: UCANNOLU Un incontro tra due simboli della Sicilia. I nostri Cannoli Siciliani, con la loro cialda croccante e la ricotta cremosa, incontrano il profumo intenso del Caffè Stagnitta, storica torrefazione palermitana nata nel 1922 dalla passione della famiglia Stagnitta per l’arte del caffè. Da quasi un secolo, tostatura, tradizione e cultura del buon lavoro si tramandano di generazione in generazione, nel cuore di Palermo. Noi abbiamo scelto di portare questa storia anche sulla nostra tavola: un cannolo, un espresso e il sapore autentico della Sicilia. 🇮🇹 La Sicilia, raccontata attraverso i suoi sapori.

candidateAudit.text: CZ: 🌱 Ptali jste se. My jsme poslouchali. 💚 Často jsme od vás slýchali, že byste v našem menu uvítali něco dobrého i pro vegany. A protože rádi plníme přání našich hostů, máme pro vás skvělou novinku! ✨ Už od příštího týdne najdete v našem jídelním lístku domácí hummus připravený z cizrny, tahini pasty a sušených rajčátek. 😍 Podáváme ho s: čerstvým salátkem, nadýchanou focacciou a křupavou pečenou cizrnou. Ať už jste vegan, nebo si jen rádi dopřejete něco lehkého a plného chuti, věříme, že si naši novinku zamilujete. ❤️ EN: 🌱 You asked. We listened. 💚 Many of you told us you’d love to see more vegan options on our menu. And because we always love listening to our guests, we’re excited to introduce something new! ✨ Starting next week, you’ll find our homemade hummus on the menu, prepared with chickpeas, tahini and sun-dried tomatoes. 😍 Served with: fresh salad, fluffy focaccia, and crispy roasted chickpeas. Whether you’re vegan or simply looking for something fresh, light and full of flavour, we think you’re going to love this new addition. ❤️ #vytopna #vytopnaprague #praguefood #praguerestaurants #vegan veganfood hummus foodie foodstagram visitprague

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A per
candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

Following the Movement of Memory with master students from artscience.ak (free entry, no registrations needed): 25 June, 15:00 2 July, 17:00 3 July, 17:00 4 July, 17:00 9 July, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. [REVERBERATED] explores notions of memory as the annual exhibition of the master’s program Art & Science. The exhibition approaches this process through the metaphor of reverberation. Reverberation describes the reflection of sound from multiple surfaces, producing many overlapping echoes at once. Just as sound continues to resonate within a space, memories reverberate through bodies, media, and environments long after the events that created them. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Opening hours Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Angewandte Festival: 1 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 2 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 3 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 4 July (Open Saturday, opening hours: 11:00–18:00) AIL, Ott

candidateAudit.text: Coming up next: Angewandte Festival! Next week AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step – starting here with an installation, coming from the research project SONIME – Sonic Memories. Sprech- und Hörbriefe in Zeiten der Migration und Mobilität [Letters of Speech and Hearing in an Era of Migration and Mobility]: In the early 1990s, dictation cassettes travel by mail between a small East German town and Vienna. They transport voices, longings, and confessions that might never have been uttered face-to-face: due to their spatial separation and a risky affair, two lovers use the dictation machine as a space for radical intimacy. Theoretically framed by the concept of media as a "language of absence," the cassettes repair broken lines and establish a technique of connectedness within absence. The distance becomes physically tangible where the medium itself is set in motion: when messages are recorded during the car ride connecting both locations, the distance is acoustically inscribed into both the narrative and the material. The dictation cassette is thus revealed as a repository of radical subjectivity. This communication, which was archived and analysed as part of the SONIME project (Sonic Memories: Audio Letters in Times of Migration and Mobility), can be heard during Angewandte Festival at AIL at two facing listening stations that make the spatial distance to be overcome physically experienceable. candidateAudit.text: Clubs sind mehr als nur Orte zum Feiern. Sie sind Räume für Kultur, Begegnung und neue Ideen 🙌 Deshalb freuen wir uns sehr, jetzt Teil von #zukunftfeiern von clubtopia zu sein und den Code of Conduct unterschrieben zu haben. 💚💫 Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns kein Trend, sondern etwas, das wir Schritt für Schritt im Cluballtag umsetzen wollen: regionale Getränke, Mehrwegsysteme, LED-Beleuchtung, Awareness-Konzept und viele weitere kleine Entscheidungen, die zusammen einen Unterschied machen. Wir wissen aber auch: Das ist erst der Anfang. Wir wollen weiter lernen, weiter verbessern und neue Wege ausprobieren. 🤝 Unser Ziel ist klar: ein Ort für Musik, Kultur und Gemeinschaft – und gleichzeitig ein Club, der Verantwortung übernimmt! Danke an clubtopia, dass wir Teil dieser Bewegung sein dürfen! Wir möchten mit euch feiern, ALS GÄBE ES EIN MORGEN! #clubkultur #nachhaltigfeiern #nightlife #viennaclub

candidateAudit.text: OSTERIA LA TANA DELLA VOLPE Qui celebriamo la tradizione culinaria italiana, con un’attenzione meticolosa alla selezione degli ingredienti, per portare in tavola un’esperienza autentica e indimenticabile. Ogni portata racconta una storia, una fusione di sapori iconici e tesori nascosti della cucina regionale, per offrire una varietà di piatti che spaziano dai classici intramontabili a preparazioni uniche e ricercate. In Osteria ogni esperienza è un viaggio attraverso il gusto, dove la perfezione di ogni piatto è al centro di tutto.
